item.text: The reproduction is conclusive: one rendered center star disappears, but the HUD jumps from `0/2` to `2/2`; one normal star remains in the world. The cause is the contract parser’s “first record” fallback selecting the first receipt row (`creditUnits=2`) instead of resolving the standby route/map chain for the descending cargo, whose receipt resolves to one unit.
